# Native fixture provenance

`reports/` contains genuine local MT5 reports with no trades, profitable-only trades, and mixed winning/losing trades. Their native HTML table structures and statistics are preserved. EA names, server labels, and a smoke nonce are sanitized; UTF-8 siblings transcode the same layouts. The fixture tester JSON files rebind hashes to the sanitized reports and explicitly identify that derivation. They are not new tester executions. `provenance.json` records original and fixture hashes. Original evidence stays outside the repository unchanged.

Independently checked native cells: no-trade net profit/trades/deals are 0/0/0; profitable-only are 10.67/6/12 with gross loss 0.00 and native profit factor 0.00; mixed are 120.86/55/110, gross profit 267.84, gross loss -146.98, winning/losing trades 30/25, balance maximal drawdown 34.50 (0.03%), and equity maximal drawdown 44.24 (0.04%). Tests must preserve distinct units and fields rather than recomputing these statistics.

`profiles/` contains untouched native CSV exports from MetaEditor build 6235, captured using a copied deterministic nontrading script. The export is UTF-16LE BOM, semicolon-separated, six cells, and has no header. Build settings were observed in the Debug options: optimization enabled; one export with inlining enabled, two with inlining disabled. Original settings were restored. Indented repeated function occurrences are preserved. Conditions sidecars bind exact export hashes, workload, compilation-unit identity, observed build conditions, and an environment fingerprint. No elapsed duration is inferred from sampling.

Profiler values checked against the native export: inlined OnStart Total/Self CPU 9134 samples (100.00%); the first non-inlined export has FixtureSeries 10716 (99.98%), FixtureFold Total 10718/Self 2 (0.02%), and OnStart Self 0. The repeat records 11042 series samples and 11044 total samples. This variation is not proof of a speed change.

`includes/` preserves a copied nontrading nested-header fixture and a sanitized genuine compiler log. Build 6235 selected the declaring header's directory when two different `Choice.mqh` files existed. The installed AlgoBook 2.9.1 explicitly describes that directory; the Reference topic's main-source wording is less precise. The inventory retains both different existing candidates as uncertainty. The local tester passed all 12 independently specified cases, including the nested include value. Provenance records source/EX5/log/tester hashes; it does not claim a complete compiler dependency fingerprint.

Synthetic mutations exercise malformed layouts, missing/special values, integrity mismatches, comparison conditions, and ambiguous mappings. Synthetic compiler/terminal/scenario executables test orchestration, not native MT5 behavior. The real compiled self-test and tester evidence are retained separately during local delivery.
